title: Add string resource info_loot_almanac_title
description: Add the string resource used to localize "Loot Almanac".
start_anchor: <string name="info_repeated_tasks_body">Set a quest to repeat daily, weekly, or monthly, at whatever interval you like. Once completed, it reappears automatically at the time you\'ve set in Settings, so recurring habits don\'t need to be recreated by hand.</string>
